details: The scale-change handler (line 335-339) starts 600ms transitions on nodeSel and labelSel without calling .interrupt() first, so rapid scale switches mid-transition cause conflicting animations and potential position snapping. All other patterns are clean: pointermove only repositions the tooltip (cheap), getR always reads the current mutable currentScale so no stale closure, pointer events unify mouse/touch, and there are no cross-view dispatches that could loop.
